avoid: Forms that belong to a task: use a normal form.
anatomy: Setting row: label, explanation, control (slot, Toggle by default).
figmaProps: Title / Description / Show description / Show actions
Setting row: Label / Description / Show description / Control
reactProps: control gets aria-labelledby and aria-describedby from the row.
behaviour: Toggles save straight away: confirm that with a Toast. Fields that belong together: Save in actions.
a11y: The label and explanation of the row become the name and description of the control.
content: Label says what it does, the explanation says what happens.
do: Group by topic: Notifications, Language, Security.
dont: Mix toggles and a Save button in one block.
name: Settings section
summary: Block on a settings page: title and explanation on the left, settings on the right in a card. Each setting has a label, an explanation and a control.
